claim: In the matching retail DLL, PlayerController_AI.ResetCheckedPriAct (0x06005007) is a parameterless instance method with an exact 29-byte body. It initializes a local Int32 index to zero, branches to a signed loop test against raw upper bound 41, and for each index satisfying index < 41 loads checkedPriAct, writes raw zero to checkedPriAct[index] with stelem.i1, increments the index by one, and repeats. It therefore clears exact raw indices 0 through 40 and returns when the index reaches 41. FACT-0029 pins the sole canonical caller seam currently closed: Player.SetLastSkill writes lastSkill, clears lastSkillHit, loads plCont_AI, then callvirt ResetCheckedPriAct at SetLastSkill IL+0x0014.
